games.name: The Persian Shadow: Cambyses' War for Egypt
games.description: Step into the world of Herodotus' Histories. Set during the Persian invasion of Egypt in the 5th Century BCE, experience Cambyses II's march across the Sinai Desert and meet key historical players along the way.

games.name: Amasis in a bind
games.description: The year is 525 BC and Amasis II is the ruler in Egypt, when he recieves a troubling herald from, Cambyses II king of the mighty Persian Empire.

games.name: Into the Sinai Desert
games.description: After being decieved by Amasis II, Cambyses II resolves to invade Egypt

games.name: The Sorrow of Psammenitus
games.description: Amasis's son, Psammenitus, endures hardships from Cambyses as a fallen king

games.name: Aesop's Fables: The Dog and the Shadow
games.description: The dog with meat in its mouth comes across something unexpected.
